## About
Joel Jonas was a master body man and painter before he opened Jammers. His shop soon built a reputation for outstanding quality work at a fair price. Al Reeves, who got his start in his dad's shop in Dallas, came on as a partner and later became sole owner. He has kept that same commitment ever since.
Ron Ostrander is our manager and lead estimator. He worked at the Lexus dealer and was a body technician before that. Kim Egyed runs the office. She and her husband owned a Ferrari repair shop for many years.
We work on all makes and models from our building on Buttercup Street, and cars come in from all over the greater Houston area. We're rated 4.9 from 88 Google reviews, and we would love you to be our next customer.

## Services
- Body work: Body work on all makes and models, from Fords to Porsches.
- Paint refinishing: One of the main things we do, on all makes and models.
- Collision repair: Collision repair on everything from Fords to European imports.
- Glass replacement
- Paintless dent repair
- Alignments
- Upholstery repairs
- Window tint

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: All makes and models, from Fords to Porsches. We're especially known for luxury imports like Mercedes, Lexus and BMW.

Q: How long has Jammers been around?
A: Jammers Auto Body has been in business since 1985, when Joel Jonas opened the shop.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Give us a call or come by anytime during business hours.
